# Erfuellung (intuitive fulfillment) - chronological ledger

*Generated by `scripts/synthesis_ledger.py` from `synthesis/extractions/erfuellung/`. Do not edit by hand - edit the extraction records and rebuild.*

*The Sixth Investigation's dynamic — an empty or signitive intention brought to coincidence (Deckung) with intuition, the series of fulfilments running toward adequation, and disappointment (Enttäuschung) as the negative case — and then what becomes of it: Ideas I's grades of evidence, Hua XI on fulfilled and frustrated protention, Erfahrung und Urteil deriving negation from disappointment, Heidegger's categorial intuition in GA 20. Two traps. First, the matcher anchors at a word start only, so a stem carries its family: 'fulfil' finds fulfilment, fulfillment, fulfilled and fulfilling (1,321 hits in 48 of the 53 documents, and it is what bridges the British/American spelling split between translations), while 'unfulfil' has to be listed separately. Second, the obvious English words are withheld on purpose: 'intuition' (3,427 hits, 49 documents), 'evidence' (2,005 in 52), 'empty', 'intuitive' and 'identification' are ordinary words at this scale, and would both swamp the ranking and make any recorded absence meaningless — 'Evidenz' is the reliable handle, as that lexicon entry already says. 'coincidence', 'fullness', 'in person' and 'verification' are kept, and are the ones to set absent_terms against by hand.*

117 units and 1 recorded absences from 12 commentaries.

### 1907 - Husserl's Thing and Space (1907)

`husserl-thing-and-space-commentary`

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/thing-and-space/001` · *leibhaftig da*
  Perception is distinguished from phantasy, image-consciousness and thought not by intentionality as such but by the mode of givenness in which the object stands there in the flesh, self-given in the current now.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s4-intentionality-as-the-essential-determination-of-perception` · Thing and Space § 4 · [§4. Intentionality as the essential determination of perception](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#intentionality-as-the-essential-determination-of-perception)
  > In perception, the object stands there as **there in the flesh** (*leibhaftig da*). More precisely: as **actually present**, as **self-given there in the current now**. This is the specific character of perceptual givenness.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/thing-and-space/002` · *leere Intentionen*
  A perception is a complex of full intentions backed by sensational material and empty intentions that lack presentational material but keep their direction toward moments of the object.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s18-the-mode-of-givenness-of-improperly-appearing-determinations` · Thing and Space § 18 · [§18. The mode of givenness of improperly appearing determinations](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-mode-of-givenness-of-improperly-appearing-determinations)
  > perception is a complex of **full intentions** (*volle Intentionen*) and **empty intentions** (*leere Intentionen*), or equivalently, full and empty rays of apprehension.

- **revised** · `erfuellung/thing-and-space/003` · *empty intentions*
  The commentary states that the full/empty terminology of the Sixth Logical Investigation is here applied to the internal structure of a single perceptual act rather than to the relation between separate acts.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s18-the-mode-of-givenness-of-improperly-appearing-determinations` · Thing and Space § 18 · [§18. The mode of givenness of improperly appearing determinations](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-mode-of-givenness-of-improperly-appearing-determinations)
  > This full/empty terminology clearly carries forward the framework from the Sixth *Logical Investigation*, but now applied specifically to the internal structure of a *single* perceptual act rather than to the relation between separate acts of different types (signitive vs. intuitive).

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/thing-and-space/004` · *empty*
  The empty apprehensional components of a perception are distinguished from obscure representations such as dim phantasies, which still present something through degraded sensational material.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s18-the-mode-of-givenness-of-improperly-appearing-determinations` · Thing and Space § 18 · [§18. The mode of givenness of improperly appearing determinations](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-mode-of-givenness-of-improperly-appearing-determinations)
  > The empty components of perceptual apprehension have no presentational material *at all*. They are a structurally distinct mode of intentional directedness.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/thing-and-space/005` · *intention and fulfillment*
  Two interwoven plays of intention and fulfillment are distinguished in the continuous synthesis: the general forward-reference from phase to phase, and a narrower one concerning increase and decrease of the completeness of presentation.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s32-intention-and-fulfillment-in-the-perceptual-process-increase-and-decrease-of` · Thing and Space § 32 · [§32. Intention and fulfillment in the perceptual process. Increase and decrease of the fullness of givenness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#intention-and-fulfillment-in-the-perceptual-process-increase-and-decrease-of-the-fullness-of-givenness)

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/thing-and-space/006` · *emptying*

  > Fulfillment proceeding in the opposite direction has its correlate in an **"emptying"** — a continuous receding from the goal, which is still what is "intended" in every phase.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/thing-and-space/007` · *fulfillment*
  The intention toward complete self-sameness is perpetually fulfilled in the increase of givenness but reaches its goal only at the maximal limit-point, where it becomes consciousness of the attained goal.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s32-intention-and-fulfillment-in-the-perceptual-process-increase-and-decrease-of` · Thing and Space § 32 · [§32. Intention and fulfillment in the perceptual process. Increase and decrease of the fullness of givenness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#intention-and-fulfillment-in-the-perceptual-process-increase-and-decrease-of-the-fullness-of-givenness)
  > This penetrating intention finds perpetual fulfillment in the perpetual increase of the consciousness of givenness, but only in the limit-point as the maximal point is the goal of the increase actually attained.

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/thing-and-space/008` · *fulfillment*
  The continuous synthesis is at any time a braid of partial syntheses of increase and decrease, having the form of fulfillment in one direction and of emptying in the other.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s33-the-role-of-improper-appearance-in-the-process-of-more-precise-determination` · Thing and Space § 33 · [§33.   > Enrichment on one side goes hand in hand with impoverishment on the other. The synthesis has the form of fulfillment in one direction and the form of emptying in the other.

  The evidence of the possibility of fulfillment is the evident possibility of phantasy appearances adapted to the perceptual appearance, which shows the direction of increase to be infinitely extendable rather than terminating in an achievable limit.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s33-the-role-of-improper-appearance-in-the-process-of-more-precise-determination` · Thing and Space § 33 · [§33. ### 1913-1928 - Husserl, Hua 3 — Ideas I, Parts 3–4

`husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary`

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/ideas-i-3-4/001` · *reine Selbstgegebenheit*
  Self-givenness, as the limit-state of clarification, is distinguished from originary, bodily or perceptual givenness.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-67-method-of-clarification-nearness-to-givenness-and-farness-from-givenness` · Ideas I § 67 · [§ 67\. Method of Clarification. "Nearness to Givenness" and "Farness from Givenness"](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#method-of-clarification-nearness-to-givenness-and-farness-from-givenness)
  > A crucial *disambiguation*: *self-givenness* (= *clarity*) ≠ *originary* givenness (= *bodily*, *perceptual* presence).

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/ideas-i-3-4/002` · *fullness*
  Fullness is the clarity-mode of givenness: a darkly and a clearly conscious object can share an identical sense while differing in fullness.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-132-the-core-as-sense-in-the-mode-of-its-fullness` · Ideas I § 132 · [§ 132\.   > So the sense (the determination-content) is identical across clarity-levels, while the fullness (the clarity) differs.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/ideas-i-3-4/003` · *full core*
  The full core of the noema is defined as the sense in the mode of its fullness.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-132-the-core-as-sense-in-the-mode-of-its-fullness` · Ideas I § 132 · [§ 132\.   > As full core we will accordingly reckon precisely the full concretion of the relevant noematic stock-piece, hence the sense in the mode of its fullness.

- **revised** · `erfuellung/ideas-i-3-4/004` · *filled or unfilled sense*
  The difference between blind and insightful judgment does not concern the sense or proposition, which is identical in both, but whether it is filled or unfilled.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-136-the-first-fundamental-form-of-reason-consciousness-originarily-giving-seei` · Ideas I § 136 · [§ 136\. The First Fundamental Form of Reason-Consciousness: Originarily-Giving "Seeing"](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#the-first-fundamental-form-of-reason-consciousness-originarily-giving-seeing)
  > The difference concerns the way how the mere sense, or proposition — which as mere abstractum in the concretion of the consciousness-noema demands a plus of completing moments — is filled or unfilled sense and proposition.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/ideas-i-3-4/005` · *fulfillment*
  Fullness alone does not decide; the how of fulfillment matters, the intuitive mode and within it the distinguished originarily-giving mode.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-136-the-first-fundamental-form-of-reason-consciousness-originarily-giving-seei` · Ideas I § 136 · [§ 136\. The First Fundamental Form of Reason-Consciousness: Originarily-Giving "Seeing"](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#the-first-fundamental-form-of-reason-consciousness-originarily-giving-seeing)
  > Fullness of the sense alone does not make it out, it depends also on the how of the fulfillment. An experience-way of the sense is the "intuitive," whereby the "meant object as such" is intuitively conscious

- **revised** · `erfuellung/ideas-i-3-4/006` · *Evidenz*
  Evidence is defined as the unity of a reason-positing with the originary givenness that essentially motivates it, with a noetic and a noematic side.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-136-the-first-fundamental-form-of-reason-consciousness-originarily-giving-seei` · Ideas I § 136 · [§ 136\. The First Fundamental Form of Reason-Consciousness: Originarily-Giving "Seeing"](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#the-first-fundamental-form-of-reason-consciousness-originarily-giving-seeing)
  > Insight, in general evidence (Evidenz) is thus a quite distinguished occurrence; according to its "core" it is the unity of a reason-positing with the it essence-wise motivating

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/ideas-i-3-4/007` · *fulfillment*
  Talk of fulfillment has a double sense: the character the thesis takes on through the mode of the sense, and the peculiarity of that sense to harbor a fullness that rationally motivates.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-136-the-first-fundamental-form-of-reason-consciousness-originarily-giving-seei` · Ideas I § 136 · [§ 136\. The First Fundamental Form of Reason-Consciousness: Originarily-Giving "Seeing"](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#the-first-fundamental-form-of-reason-consciousness-originarily-giving-seeing)
  > Once it is "fulfillment of the intention," as a character that the actual thesis takes on through the special mode of the sense; the other time it is precisely the peculiarity of this mode itself, or the peculiarity of the relevant sense, to harbor in itself a "fullness" that rationally motivates.

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/ideas-i-3-4/008` · *unanimous fulfillment*
  In the inadequate sphere of realities, the experience-course fills the empty places of preceding appearances in unanimous fulfillment whose reason-power steadily increases, and positings gain weight.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-138-adequate-and-inadequate-evidence` · Ideas I § 138 · [§ 138\. Adequate and Inadequate Evidence](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#adequate-and-inadequate-evidence)
  > precisely the experience-course in which the empty-places of the preceding appearances fill themselves, the indeterminacies determine themselves more closely, and so constantly in the way of thoroughgoing unanimous fulfillment with its steadily self-increasing reason-power.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/ideas-i-3-4/009` · *Deckung*
  An evident and a non-evident act of the same sense can come to coincidence, in which the evident positing confirms the non-evident one.

### 1917 to 1918 - Husserl, Hua 33 — Die Bernauer Manuskripte über das Zeitbewußtsein

`husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary`

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/hua-33/001` · *fulfillment*
  Ur-presentation is not an appearing of ur-presences that only afterwards take on intentionality, but a continual appearing of them in the mode of fulfillment of expectation-intentions.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h4-s-1-the-intentionality-of-ur-presentation-the-attentive-turning-toward-a-present` · Hua XXXIII Text Nr. 1 § 1 · [§ 1\. The Intentionality of Ur-Presentation. The Attentive Turning toward a Present-New, Past, or Future](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#the-intentionality-of-ur-presentation-the-attentive-turning-toward-a-present-new-past-or-future)
  > the ur-presentation is not a mere appearing of ur-presences that would only subsequently take on intentionality, but a continual appearing of them in the mode of fulfillment of expectation-intentions.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/hua-33/002` · *empty concrete retention*
  An empty concrete retention can find fulfillment only through a recollection that quasi-constitutes the same perception anew, and fulfillment in reverse running is impossible.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h4-s-1-the-intentionality-of-ur-presentation-the-attentive-turning-toward-a-present` · Hua XXXIII Text Nr. 1 § 1 · [§ 1\. The Intentionality of Ur-Presentation. The Attentive Turning toward a Present-New, Past, or Future](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#the-intentionality-of-ur-presentation-the-attentive-turning-toward-a-present-new-past-or-future)
  > There is a primal law: an empty concrete retention can find fulfillment only through a recollection that (quasi-)constitutes anew the concrete perception of the same event in the mode of "re-consciousness" (*Wiederbewußtsein*).

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/hua-33/003` · *fulfilled expectation*
  Every middle phase of the primal process has a triple face, being retention of elapsed ur-data, retention of elapsed apprehensions, and fulfilled expectation from which an empty horizon of unfulfilled expectation radiates.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h4-s-2-the-interweaving-of-retentional-and-protentional-intentionality-in-the-cours` · Hua XXXIII Text Nr. 1 § 2 · [§ 2\. The Interweaving of Retentional and Protentional Intentionality in the Course of the Primal Process](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#the-interweaving-of-retentional-and-protentional-intentionality-in-the-course-of-the-primal-process)
  > Every constituting total-phase is retention of fulfilled protention, which is the limit of a horizon of unfulfilled and itself continuously mediate protention (a stretch-continuum).

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/hua-33/004` · *fulfillment*
  Consciousness becomes both retentional and protentional continuity, steadily fulfillable such that every fulfillment is simultaneously intention for a new fulfillment.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h4-s-2-the-interweaving-of-retention-and-protention-as-fulfillment-process` · Hua XXXIII Text Nr. 2 § 2 · [§ 2\.   > In essence, it is steadily fulfillable such that every fulfillment is simultaneously intention for a new fulfillment, and so on.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/hua-19-2/014` · *evidence*

### 1923-1924 - Husserl, Hua 7 — Erste Philosophie I

`husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary`

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/hua-7/001` · *fulfillment-synthesis*
  A general essence can be emptily thought or intuited as itself, and the synthesis of identification shows the merely meant and the self-given to be numerically one, through a fulfillment-synthesis.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-eighteenth-lecture-the-misrecognition-of-the-intuitive-self-givenness-of-the-gen` · Hua VII, Eighteenth Lecture · [Eighteenth Lecture: The misrecognition of the intuitive self-givenness of the general essences](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#eighteenth-lecture-the-misrecognition-of-the-intuitive-self-givenness-of-the-general-essences)
  > possibly the same once merely meant and then itself given. Here too the *fulfillment-synthesis*, leading the meant back to the self-grasped,

- **criticized** · `erfuellung/hua-7/002` · *evidence*
  Construing evidence as a light or feeling that indexes truth generates the Cartesian circle, which the insight that evidence is the self-givenness of the matter dissolves.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-eighteenth-lecture-the-misrecognition-of-the-intuitive-self-givenness-of-the-gen` · Hua VII, Eighteenth Lecture · [Eighteenth Lecture: The misrecognition of the intuitive self-givenness of the general essences](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#eighteenth-lecture-the-misrecognition-of-the-intuitive-self-givenness-of-the-general-essences)
  > so long as evidence is construed as a mere *index* — a light or feeling accompanying certain judgments — one must then prove, circularly, that this index points to truth

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/hua-7/003` · *self-giving evidence*
  Every kind of objectivity has its own immediacy of givenness and kind of self-giving evidence, and the unity of a proof is self-given only in carrying out its synthesis, even for a God.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-eighteenth-lecture-the-misrecognition-of-the-intuitive-self-givenness-of-the-gen` · Hua VII, Eighteenth Lecture · [Eighteenth Lecture: The misrecognition of the intuitive self-givenness of the general essences](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#eighteenth-lecture-the-misrecognition-of-the-intuitive-self-givenness-of-the-general-essences)
  > *Every kind of objectivity has its immediacy of givenness, its kind of intuition, of self-giving evidence.*

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/hua-7/004` · *intuitive fulfillment*
  The concepts in an individual judgment like 'this tone is higher than that' fulfil themselves through intuition, but not through merely sensuous experience of the two tones.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-nineteenth-lecture-the-necessity-of-the-extension-of-the-idea-of-intuition` · Hua VII, Nineteenth Lecture · [Nineteenth Lecture: The necessity of the extension of the idea of intuition](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#nineteenth-lecture-the-necessity-of-the-extension-of-the-idea-of-intuition)
  > According to sense, the word-senses "tone" and "higher" fulfill themselves through intuition — but not through the merely *sensuous* experience of two tones and a sensuous conjunction of both

- **revised** · `erfuellung/hua-7/005` · *fulfillment*
  Experience or intuition is identified with evidence, the self-grasping of the meant as meant, and evidence-shapes are shapes of possible fulfillment of unfulfilled thought-intentions.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-nineteenth-lecture-the-necessity-of-the-extension-of-the-idea-of-intuition` · Hua VII, Nineteenth Lecture · [Nineteenth Lecture: The necessity of the extension of the idea of intuition](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#nineteenth-lecture-the-necessity-of-the-extension-of-the-idea-of-intuition)
  > in the evidence-shapes possible and true sense — as shape of possible fulfillment of unfulfilled thought-intentions, a fulfillment in the shape of self-giving, or in "measuring" to such shape.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/hua-7/006` · *synthesis of clarification and confirmation*
  The empiricist demand to measure meanings against self-giving intuitions presupposes, without describing it, the synthesis in which an unclear thought appropriates fulfilling clarity.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-twenty-third-lecture-hume-s-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-a` · Hua VII, Twenty-third Lecture · [Twenty-third Lecture: Hume's nominalistic reduction of all ideas to impressions and the countersense in this principle](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#twenty-third-lecture-humes-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-and-the-countersense-in-this-principle)
  > the description of the *synthesis of clarification and confirmation*, of justification and its negative counterpart, dis-justification

- **revised** · `erfuellung/hua-7/007` · *confirmation*
  Hume's impression, rightly understood, is a title for evidence-consciousness: not the thing but only the self-intuition of the thing can confirm a mere meaning.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-twenty-third-lecture-hume-s-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-a` · Hua VII, Twenty-third Lecture · [Twenty-third Lecture: Hume's nominalistic reduction of all ideas to impressions and the countersense in this principle](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#twenty-third-lecture-humes-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-and-the-countersense-in-this-principle)
  > A real thing, which as such merely *is*, confirms nothing and has in itself nothing confirming. Not the thing can confirm, but only the *self-intuition* of the thing

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/hua-7/008` · *confirmation-needing meanings*
  'Idea' is a title for all confirmable and confirmation-needing meanings, conscious of what is meant in them but not self-given.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-twenty-third-lecture-hume-s-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-a` · Hua VII, Twenty-third Lecture · [Twenty-third Lecture: Hume's nominalistic reduction of all ideas to impressions and the countersense in this principle](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#twenty-third-lecture-humes-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-and-the-countersense-in-this-principle)
  > the analogous holds naturally for the counter-title "idea," as title for all confirmable and confirmation-needing meanings: each is double-sidedly consciousness of in-it-conscious, in-it-meant, but *not* self-given.

*Partial pass: Eighteenth, Nineteenth and Twenty-third Lectures (lines 655-714 and 791-826): the paragraphs carrying fulfilment vocabulary. Not read: the First, Fourth, Fifth, Sixth and Twelfth Lectures (4-8 hits each) and the rest of the commentary.*

### 1963 - Michel Henry, L'essence de la manifestation

`henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary`

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/henry-em/001` · *Erfüllung*
  Henry's summary of Husserl has signifying intentions find a fulfillment that can reach the living presence of the thing, and the way this fulfillment operates defines the degree of evidence.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-1-the-idea-of-an-apodictic-evidence-as-privileged-pathway-of-access-to-the-bei` · EM § 1 · [§ 1\. The idea of an apodictic evidence as privileged pathway of access to the being of the ego](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#the-idea-of-an-apodictic-evidence-as-privileged-pathway-of-access-to-the-being-of-the-ego)
  > Henry continues: the way in which this fulfillment operates defines the degree of the evidence.

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/henry-em/002` · *fulfilled*
  At the highest degree of perfection is an originary evidence in which all elements of the signifying intention are fulfilled by a corresponding intuition, but it is perfect only if it cannot be belied by later experience.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-1-the-idea-of-an-apodictic-evidence-as-privileged-pathway-of-access-to-the-bei` · EM § 1 · [§ 1\. The idea of an apodictic evidence as privileged pathway of access to the being of the ego](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#the-idea-of-an-apodictic-evidence-as-privileged-pathway-of-access-to-the-being-of-the-ego)
  > at the highest degree of perfection, we find an immediate, originary evidence in which the diverse elements of signifying intention by which consciousness aims at the object are all fulfilled by a corresponding intuition

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/henry-em/003` · *intuitive fulfillment*
  The ego becomes the theme of a consciousness seeking apodicticity only because it alone can furnish an adequate intuitive fulfillment.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-1-the-idea-of-an-apodictic-evidence-as-privileged-pathway-of-access-to-the-bei` · EM § 1 · [§ 1\. The idea of an apodictic evidence as privileged pathway of access to the being of the ego](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#the-idea-of-an-apodictic-evidence-as-privileged-pathway-of-access-to-the-being-of-the-ego)
  > The ego arises before it only because it is the sole being capable of furnishing to such a consciousness an adequate intuitive fulfillment.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/henry-em/004` · *fulfillment*
  Three senses of intuition are distinguished: every presenting act, a consciousness whose signifying intentions are fulfilled, and the fulfilling given itself.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-3-the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomeno` · EM § 3 · [§ 3\. The overcoming of intuitionism and the liberation of the universal phenomenological horizon](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomenological-horizon)
  > (3) The fulfillment itself of intuition, understood as the arising of a given to which the signifying intentions of consciousness come to adjoin themselves in a rigorous correspondence.

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/henry-em/005` · *fulfillment*
  The content that gives fulfillment the occasion to occur remains the true goal of intentional life, which is why rational life stays oriented by being-there.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-3-the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomeno` · EM § 3 · [§ 3\. The overcoming of intuitionism and the liberation of the universal phenomenological horizon](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomenological-horizon)
  > the content that must give this fulfillment the occasion to be produced — which remains the true goal of intentional life

- **criticized** · `erfuellung/henry-em/006` · *perfect fulfillment*
  The ideal of a consciousness whose signifying intentions are all intuitively realized is questioned as a dangerous ideal in which forgetting of the origin is engendered.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-3-the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomeno` · EM § 3 · [§ 3\. The overcoming of intuitionism and the liberation of the universal phenomenological horizon](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomenological-horizon)

  The commentary states that if the horizon of unfulfilled co-intentions belongs to consciousness in principle, it is a positive ontological structure, not a deficit of intuition.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-3-the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomeno` · EM § 3 · [§ 3\. The overcoming of intuitionism and the liberation of the universal phenomenological horizon](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomenological-horizon)

The overcoming of intuitionism and the liberation of the universal phenomenological horizon](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomenological-horizon)

  Henry proposes beginning not from fulfilled intuition but from the confused, non-intuitive consciousness before fulfillment, still immersed in the horizon.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-3-the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomeno` · EM § 3 · [§ 3\. The overcoming of intuitionism and the liberation of the universal phenomenological horizon](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#the-overcoming-of-intuitionism-and-the-liberation-of-the-universal-phenomenological-horizon)

### 1989 - Commentary on Jean-Luc Marion, Réduction et donation: Recherches sur Husserl, Heidegger et la phénoménologie

`marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary`

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/marion-rd/001` · *fulfilment*
  Marion reads §45 as resting on the essential homogeneity of the fulfilment function, by which every signifying intention demands at least the possibility of intuitive fulfilment.
  `marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary#h3-2-the-domains-of-intuition` · Réduction et donation I, 2 · [2 - The Domains of Intuition](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary.html#the-domains-of-intuition)
  > A principle: the essential homogeneity of the function of fulfilment, so that whatever the signifying intentions, all in principle demand at least the possibility of intuitive fulfilment.

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/marion-rd/002` · *fulfilling intuition*
  The bare 'is' of 'gold is yellow' calls for its own fulfilling intuition, confirmed negatively by the distinguishable absence of its fulfilment.
  `marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary#h3-2-the-domains-of-intuition` · Réduction et donation I, 2 · [2 - The Domains of Intuition](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary.html#the-domains-of-intuition)
  > Strictly categorial intentions therefore call for a corresponding fulfilling intuition. Confirmation comes from the negative case

- **revised** · `erfuellung/marion-rd/003` · *fulfilment*
  The possibilities of error, disappointment and adequate or partial fulfilment require that signification precede intuition and receive from the intuitive given only a confirmation of itself.
  `marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary#h3-5-presence-without-intuition` · Réduction et donation I, 5 · [5 - Presence without Intuition](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary.html#presence-without-intuition)
  > The phenomenological possibilities of error, disappointment, adequate or partial fulfilment all require that signification precede intuition and that even when filled with an intuitive given it first receive from that given a confirmation of itself, hence of its sense.

- **revised** · `erfuellung/marion-rd/004` · *adequate fulfilment*
  Inadequacy of intuitive fulfilment, shown by mathematical idealities, is not an exception but an absolute rule.
  `marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary#h3-5-presence-without-intuition` · Réduction et donation I, 5 · [5 - Presence without Intuition](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary.html#presence-without-intuition)
  > Inadequacy — the overflow of intuition by intention, signification's overhang — is not an exception but an absolute rule.

- **criticized** · `erfuellung/marion-rd/005` · *fulfilling intuition*
  Against Derrida's reading of LI I § 11, Marion holds that Husserl refuses to deny a signification its truth because it lacks fulfilling intuition.
  `marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary#h3-5-presence-without-intuition` · Réduction et donation I, 5 · [5 - Presence without Intuition](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary.html#presence-without-intuition)
  > Husserl's own thesis will be the refusal to deny a signification its truth on the grounds that it lacks fulfilling intuition.

- **criticized** · `erfuellung/marion-rd/006` · *fulfilling intuition*
  Marion's single thesis is that in the Logical Investigations signification gives itself evidently without depending on fulfilling intuition.
  `marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary#h3-5-presence-without-intuition` · Réduction et donation I, 5 · [5 - Presence without Intuition](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary.html#presence-without-intuition)
  > in the *Logical Investigations*, signification gives itself evidently without depending on fulfilling intuition.

- **revised** · `erfuellung/marion-rd/007` · *fulfilment*
  The enlargement of intuition implies signification's autonomy, because intuition can extend only by extending its fulfilment and so depends on signified spaces already given.
  `marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary#h3-6-the-evidence-of-givenness` · Réduction et donation I, 6 · [6 - The Evidence of Givenness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary.html#the-evidence-of-givenness)
  > Intuition can extend only by extending its fulfilment, hence by depending on the signified spaces to be filled.

- **criticized** · `erfuellung/marion-rd/008` · *categorial intuition*
  Categorial intuition neither gives nor sees the 'is'; it is an indication of a givenness it does not itself perform.
  `marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary#h3-7-givenness-as-question` · Réduction et donation I, 7 · [7 - Givenness as Question](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-reduction-et-donation-commentary.html#givenness-as-question)
  > Categorial intuition neither gives nor even sees the *is*: it marks — the paradox is exact — the in fact anonymous givenness of the *is*. Categorial intuition functions as an indication of a givenness it does not itself perform.

### 1994 - Rudolf Bernet, La vie du sujet: Recherches sur l'interprétation de Husserl dans la phénoménologie — Commentary

`bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary`

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/bernet-vs/001` · *intuitive fulfilment*
  Because a perceptual statement contains forms with no counterpart in sensible perception, a categorial intuition is needed to secure its intuitive fulfilment.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-the-intentionality-of-sensible-and-categorial-acts` · La Vie du sujet pp. 47-48 · [The Intentionality of Sensible and Categorial Acts](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#the-intentionality-of-sensible-and-categorial-acts)
  > Hence the need for a categorial intuition to justify the truth of a perceptual statement, that is, to secure what Husserl calls its intuitive fulfilment.

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/bernet-vs/002` · *signitive*
  In the Investigations the empty component surrounding the intuitive givenness of a spatial thing is called the signitive content of perception, making thing-perception a mixed representation.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-2` · La Vie du sujet pp. 125-126 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-1)
  > In the *Investigations* this empty component of intuitive representation is called the *signitive* content of the perception of a thing

- **criticized** · `erfuellung/bernet-vs/003` · *signitive representation*
  Bernet rejects the signitive model of the unseen side: the empty component is the anticipation of a possible perception, not the interpretation of a sign.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-2` · La Vie du sujet p. 126 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-1)
  > What I see of the thing without really seeing it is the object of a possible seeing: what is in question is the anticipation of an actual perception and a possible originary givenness, not the interpretation of a sign

- **criticized** · `erfuellung/bernet-vs/004` · *adequate representation*
  The Investigations' ideal of adequacy for external perception is said to be borrowed from internal perception, an ideal it is absurd for external perception to be guided by.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-2` · La Vie du sujet p. 128 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-1)
  > Husserl seems for a moment to have forgotten that it is absurd to suppose external perception could be guided by an ideal belonging to the form of internal perception.

- **revised** · `erfuellung/bernet-vs/005` · *empty intentional horizon*
  Ideen I is said to understand the inadequacy of thing-perception as inseparability from an empty horizon of further appearances, so that a contradictory appearance always remains possible.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-2` · La Vie du sujet p. 129 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-1)
  > A perception or appearance is called inadequate because it is inseparable from an empty intentional horizon containing the anticipation of other possible and complementary appearances of the same object.

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/bernet-vs/006` · *Deckung*
  The continuous synthesis of appearances is a sensible synthesis of fusion or covering which, given the perceiver's interest, has the form of a process of intuitive fulfilment.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-2` · La Vie du sujet p. 132 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-1)
  > Taking that interest and the teleological movement it imprints on the process into account, we discover that the continuous synthesis of appearances has the form of a process of intuitive fulfilment.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/bernet-vs/007` · *Entfüllung*
  Because the ideal of adequate givenness is inaccessible, the synthesis of fulfilment is at the same time a synthesis of emptying or unfulfilment, open to disappointment.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-2` · La Vie du sujet p. 133 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-1)
  > The synthesis of fulfilment is therefore at the same time a synthesis of emptying (*Entleerung*) or unfulfilment (*Entfüllung*), since what is gained in intuitiveness by one appearance is lost by another.

- **revised** · `erfuellung/bernet-vs/008` · *perceptual fulfilment*
  The unlimited process of perceptual fulfilment is also a process of transcendental constitution, the thing being the synthetic unity of its appearances.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-2` · La Vie du sujet pp. 133-134 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-1)
  > This unlimited process of perceptual fulfilment is also a process of transcendental constitution of the thing that appears

- **criticized** · `erfuellung/bernet-vs/009` · *adequate givenness*
  Gurwitsch's identification of the thing-in-itself with the totality of its appearances is said to risk falling back into the Investigations' contradictory ideal of adequacy, against Ideen I's Idea in the Kantian sense.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-2` · La Vie du sujet p. 136 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-1)
  > Gurwitsch would thereby lose the benefit of *Ideen I*'s analysis, on which the adequate givenness of the thing-in-itself is an Idea in the Kantian sense

*Partial pass: 'The Intentionality of Sensible and Categorial Acts' (pp. 46-48) and II.1 sections I and II (pp. 125-136): the paragraphs carrying fulfilment vocabulary. Not read: the noema sections, 'A Hermeneutic Conception of Perception', 'Genesis of Objectivism…', 'Intentionality and Transcendence', II.1 section III, and the rest of the book.*

### undated - Husserl Erfahrung und Urteil Commentary

`husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary`

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/eu/001` · *fulfillment*
  Mere judging is an intentional modification of evident judging, and every judgment, even an empty one, carries a reference to possible fulfillment.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h4-a-mere-judging-as-an-intentional-modification-of-evident-judging` · EU § 5 a) · [a) Mere Judging as an Intentional Modification of Evident Judging](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#a-mere-judging-as-an-intentional-modification-of-evident-judging)
  > every judgment, even one made emptily, carries within itself a reference to possible fulfillment, to a possible return to the things themselves.

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/eu/002` · *empty judgment*
  Emptier forms of consciousness presuppose fuller ones, and the genetic regress traces intentional modifications back to their fulfilling originals.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h4-a-mere-judging-as-an-intentional-modification-of-evident-judging` · EU § 5 a) · [a) Mere Judging as an Intentional Modification of Evident Judging](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#a-mere-judging-as-an-intentional-modification-of-evident-judging)
  > Empty judgment presupposes the possibility of filled, evident judgment; and filled judgment presupposes the objectual givenness of the substrates.

- **revised** · `erfuellung/eu/003` · *coincidence-synthesis*
  Equality and similarity in static description are products of coincidence-syntheses, total for equals and partial with conflict for similars, which are called association.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h3-s16-the-field-of-passive-pregivennesses-and-its-associative-structure` · EU § 16 · [§16. The Field of Passive Pregivennesses and Its Associative Structure](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#the-field-of-passive-pregivennesses-and-its-associative-structure)
  > What in a purely static description gives itself as equality or similarity is thus itself already to be regarded as the product of one or another kind of coincidence-synthesis

- **presupposed** · `erfuellung/eu/004` · *fulfillment*
  In unhindered perception the fulfillment of the interest's tendencies is at once fulfillment of the expectation-intentions and closer determination of the object.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h3-s21-the-inhibition-of-tendencies-and-the-origin-of-the-modalizations-of-certaint` · EU § 21 · [§21. The Inhibition of Tendencies and the Origin of the Modalizations of Certainty](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#the-inhibition-of-tendencies-and-the-origin-of-the-modalizations-of-certainty)
  > The satisfaction of the interest, the fulfillment of the tendencies in striving-onward from phase to phase, is at once fulfillment of the expectation-intentions.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/eu/005` · *Enttäuschung*
  Disappointment of an expectation-intention presupposes a measure of continuing fulfillment and a unity of objectual sense maintained through the changing appearances.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h4-a-the-origin-of-negation` · EU § 21 a) · [a) The Origin of Negation](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#a-the-origin-of-negation)
  > A certain measure of continuing fulfillment is presupposed throughout, and correlatively, a certain unity of the objectual sense must maintain itself through the flow of changing appearances.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/eu/006` · *negation*
  The disappointment of perceptual expectation is the original phenomenon of negation, which thus appears in primal form in pre-predicative receptive experience.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h4-a-the-origin-of-negation` · EU § 21 a) · [a) The Origin of Negation](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#a-the-origin-of-negation)
  > Negation is thus not first a matter of predicative judging but already appears in its primal form in the pre-predicative sphere of receptive experience.

- **revised** · `erfuellung/eu/007` · *fulfillment*
  Cognitive action is paralleled with desiring striving: both run from unfulfilled aiming through rising fulfillment to attainment, the goal of cognition being knowledge.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h3-s48-cognitive-action-paralleled-with-practical-action` · EU § 48 · [§48. Cognitive Action Paralleled with Practical Action](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#cognitive-action-paralleled-with-practical-action)
  > the goal is knowledge, and we distinguish the completely unfulfilled aiming and its rising fulfillment in the cognitive action up to complete attainment, until the object stands before us as completely known.

- **introduced** · `erfuellung/eu/008` · *fulfillment*
  Each step of cognition is both fulfillment with clarity and intuitiveness and fulfillment of the cognitive striving, whose satisfaction concerns the mode of cognition, not the being of the object.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h3-s48-cognitive-action-paralleled-with-practical-action` · EU § 48 · [§48. Cognitive Action Paralleled with Practical Action](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#cognitive-action-paralleled-with-practical-action)
  > Every step of cognition is determined by the fact that it means not merely fulfillment with clarity and intuitiveness but at the same time fulfillment of the cognitive striving and thereby its rising satisfaction.
